rules.if: candidate names a law/article and states only a substantive rule, without explicit document-version semantics
version status, publication/effective date or history appears only in the supplied Evidence metadata
rules.then: do not infer candidate version-claim presence from Evidence; apply candidate-only scope test

rules.if: candidate explicitly asserts amendment/revision, including an amendment-decision document identity
rules.then: version_claim_status is PRESENT_*; determine correctness from frozen Evidence

rules.if: candidate asserts only adoption, promulgation, publication, meeting passage, order number or publication date without explicit version semantics
candidate explicitly compares historical/original and revised/newer versions and frozen Evidence supports the comparison
